I found three Marrow Agrisupply sites in #central-team and sent you the list in our DM:

1. Eastbank. Hollis posted this on 9 Jun 2026 at 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. The file calls the doors E1/E2 but the booking sheet uses 01/02, and that has to be sorted before anyone reimports or they'll get duplicates.
2. Pine Crossing. You posted this on 9 Jun 2026 at 10:48 AM. The morning receiver's appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift, so a driver who arrived at 7:10 was written down on a sticky note.
3. Wichita store. You mentioned this on 2 Jul 2025 at 9:21 AM, an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher. Nobody calls it Marrow in so many words. I counted it because Tobias had just said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link, and you said you'd left that room open after the Wichita call.

I left out two sites that came up in the same thread but belong to other customers: the Tulsa hub (Tansley Parcel) and Door 6 on ticket #88412 (Tansleigh Packaging).

The 9 Jun thread says three rows on the tracker just said "waiting," but only Eastbank and Pine Crossing are named. The full store list was never posted in the channel, so you may want to check with store ops before the call.
